text:
alex.k: Heads up — finalizing the A/B pricing experiment rollout tomorrow. We need a quick decision on grandfathering eligibility and whether to issue invoice offsets for affected customers.

sophie: What scenarios are we covering? Existing customers with active subscriptions, recent trials, and customers who upgraded in the last 30d?

alex.k: Good Q. Proposal from product: grandfather active subscriptions that were created before the experiment start time (T0), but not ones that started during the experiment. Trials get no automatic grandfathers, but we can offer manual credits.

miguel: From billing ops POV the tricky part is offsets on reconciled invoices. If someone already got billed at old rates then we either (A) issue a credit memo on next invoice, or (B) issue an immediate invoice credit. Preference?

anya: For scale I'd prefer credit memos applied to next invoice. Less pressure on AR and avoids mid-cycle refunds. But we need a clear customer-facing message.

alex.k: Agreed. Plan: apply credit memos for eligible invoices. For any invoice already paid and aged < 14 days we can optionally trigger an immediate refund — will escalate to finance lead.

sophie: Need list of customers flagged as grandfathered. Miguel, can billing ops produce cohort by T0 and tag them? Suggest add a flag `experiment_grandfather=true` in billing system.

miguel: Yes. I'll run a query and tag customers. SQL I plan to run:```sql
-- customers with subscription_created_at < '2025-11-01T00:00:00Z' and active_on_T0
select customer_id from subscriptions where created_at < '2025-11-01' and status='active';
```

miguel: After tagging, I'll export to csv for product and support.

anya: What about customers who moved from PAYG to reserved in the last cycle? Are they eligible?

alex.k: Edge-case: If billing cycle changed (PAYG -> reserved) within 30 days of T0 we'll do manual review. Add `grandfather_review` queue for that export.

sophie: Vendor question: partner marketplaces — if partner billing already passed through different rates, do we still credit customer? We need legal/partner ops input.

miguel: For marketplaces where we don't control billing flow, we'll mark affected accounts with `partner_passthrough=true` and hand off to partner-ops.

billing-bot: Reminder: automated script will run tagging job at 02:00 UTC. Watch for failures in #eng-billing.

alex.k: Action items: 1) Miguel run tag + export (due EOD). 2) Sophie draft customer email template for credits and manual refund policy. 3) Anya own review queue and route to finance lead for refunds. 4) Product to confirm T0 in the doc.

anya: I'll take the review queue. Also please include a small report column `estimated_credit_usd` so finance knows exposure.

miguel: Will add estimated_credit_usd using historical usage * (old_rate - new_rate). Quick sanity check script snippet in Python:```py
est = sum(line.usage_tokens * (old_rate - new_rate) for line in invoice_lines)
```

sophie: I'll draft the email and ping legal/partner-ops for the marketplace exception.

alex.k: Thanks team. If there are no objections I'll lock this plan at 16:00 PT and start the tagging job overnight. :thumbsup:

sophie: No objections from me. :+1:

miguel: Go ahead.

anya: Approved from my side.

billing-bot: Tagging job started at 02:03 UTC — 1,254 customers flagged as `experiment_grandfather=true`. See export: https://internal.redwood/exports/1972468100-grandfather-export.csv
